# Idea: <working title>

Used by `/liftoff` Step 1 when the user has no idea yet: generate 2-3
candidates using this template, score each with the rubric below, then move
the winner into `docs/templates/prd.md`.

## Pitch

One sentence: what it is, for whom.

## User

The concrete person who'd use this first.

## Pain

The specific pain they have today, without this product.

## Alternative

What they do today instead (a competitor, a spreadsheet, nothing) — every
idea has an alternative, even if it's "suffer."

## Wedge

Why this product wins the first sliver of that user's attention — the one
thing it does better than the alternative.

## Risks

The 1-3 things most likely to sink this (market, technical, regulatory).

## Scoring rubric (1-5 each)

| Dimension   | Score | Why                                           |
| ----------- | ----- | --------------------------------------------- |
| Pain        |       | How acute is the problem for the target user? |
| Reach       |       | How many people have this problem?            |
| Feasibility |       | Can Liftkit's stack build this in v1?         |
| Moat        |       | Why won't this get crushed by an incumbent?   |

Pick the idea with the highest total that also passes the `/liftoff` fit
check (web app, not mobile/ML-pipeline/realtime-heavy).
